seasonalRecommendations.title: Fresh Spring Picks
seasonalRecommendations.description: Discover sweet field strawberries, crisp leafy greens, tender baby carrots, and rosemary arriving with warmer weather.

seasonalRecommendations.title: Vibrant Summer Harvest
seasonalRecommendations.description: Enjoy sweet tomatoes, blueberries, bell peppers, blackberries, yellow peaches, sweet corn, and fragrant basil.

seasonalRecommendations.title: Rich Autumn Bounty
seasonalRecommendations.description: Savor sweet potatoes, crisp apples, broccoli florets, wildflower honey, and freshly baked country sourdough loaves.

seasonalRecommendations.title: Winter Comforts
seasonalRecommendations.description: Nourish your family with fresh spinach, farmhouse butter, butternut squash, and sweet Valencia oranges.
